name: GAEB DA XML 3.3 — Data Exchange Phases
description: Validates GAEB data exchange files across the four principal phases: X81 (cost estimate / Kostenberechnung), X83 (tender / Angebotsaufforderung), X84 (bid / Angebotsabgabe), and X86 (award / Auftragserteilung). Checks XML structure compliance, mandatory GAEB elements, LV numbering consistency, unit and quantity integrity, and price completeness per phase.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
